title: Bali Paradise Escape
excerpt: Discover the magic of Bali with pristine beaches, ancient temples, and lush rice terraces.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bali! Transfer to your resort and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Beach Day
itinerary.description: Relax on pristine beaches or try water sports activities.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping
itinerary.description: Boat trip to nearby islands for snorkeling and beach exploration.

itinerary.description: Enjoy a traditional Balinese spa treatment and watch the famous sunset.

itinerary.description: Transfer to airport for your flight home.

itinerary.description: Arrive in Zurich and transfer to your first mountain destination.

itinerary.title: Jungfrau Region
itinerary.description: Explore the famous Jungfrau region with stunning mountain views.

itinerary.title: Alpine Hiking
itinerary.description: Guided hike through pristine alpine meadows and glacial lakes.

itinerary.title: Glacier Experience
itinerary.description: Visit the Aletsch Glacier, Europe's longest glacier.

itinerary.title: Zermatt & Matterhorn
itinerary.description: Travel to Zermatt for views of the iconic Matterhorn.

itinerary.title: Mountain Railways
itinerary.description: Experience scenic mountain railway journeys.

itinerary.description: Visit beautiful Lake Lucerne and surrounding villages.

itinerary.description: Transfer to Zurich airport for departure.

itinerary.description: Visit the iconic Mt. Fuji and surrounding lakes.

itinerary.title: Bullet Train to Kyoto
itinerary.description: Experience the famous Shinkansen to ancient Kyoto.

itinerary.title: Kyoto Temples
itinerary.description: Visit UNESCO World Heritage temples and shrines.

itinerary.title: Geisha District
itinerary.description: Explore Gion and experience traditional tea ceremony.

itinerary.title: Nara Day Trip
itinerary.description: Visit Nara's friendly deer and giant Buddha.

itinerary.title: Osaka Food Tour
itinerary.description: Experience Osaka's famous street food culture.

itinerary.description: Explore at your own pace or join optional activities.
